'''Juric''' is one of [[Bair]]'s [[gai'shain]].
==Activities==
Bair tells [[Egwene]] and the other [[Wise Ones]] that Juric and [[Beira]], two of her gai'shain, have refused to put off the white even though they have served their time as gai'shain. She has beaten them until her arm wearies, but no matter how many times she tells them to put off the white, they are back in their white robes before sunset.{{Ref/book|6|15}}

== Unclear relation ==
The Wheel of Time Companion declares that it was Amys who has beaten Juric. In the book it is not explicit but rather Bair said it than Amys.{{Ref|{{twotc}}, Juric}}
